question: Choose the antonym of 'mature":
solution:
The correct answer is: **Immature**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Mature"** refers to someone or something that is fully developed, grown, or exhibits qualities of being responsible or sensible. (परिपक्व)

 
 
• **Example:** The child showed a mature understanding of the situation, surprising everyone.
 
 
 
• **Immature** means not fully developed or grown, or lacking the qualities of responsibility and sensibility that come with age or experience. (अपरिपक्व)
 
 
• **Example:** His immature behavior in the meeting made it difficult to take him seriously.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Mature'** is **'Immature'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Immature**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Developed** (विकसित): Something that has reached an advanced stage of growth or progress.

 
 
• **Example:** The city has developed rapidly in the last decade.
 
 
 
• **Experienced** (अनुभवी): Having knowledge or skill in a particular field, often as a result of time spent doing something.
 
 
• **Example:** An experienced teacher knows how to handle different types of students.
 
 
 
• **Grown** (बढ़ा हुआ): Having reached full size or maturity, often used in reference to living beings.
 
 
• **Example:** The fully grown tree provides shade to the entire park.
